items.text:
I stayed at the Hotel Meridian for a conference last month. The location was convenient, but the Wi-Fi was unreliable and the breakfast ran out early. The staff were friendly enough, though check-in took nearly an hour.

What really bothered me was the noise from the street—I barely slept the first two nights. For the price, I expected better soundproofing. The gym was small but functional, and the rooftop bar had a nice view.

Overall, it’s fine if you’re on a tight budget, but don’t expect luxury.
